## File: facebookresearch_mvfst-rl/third-party/torchbeast/third_party/grpc/tools/release/release_notes.py

Prompts

```
['run the script to generate draft release notes in Markdown from GitHub PRs between two git tags', 'run the script to generate final release notes organized by language from labeled PRs', 'get merge commit logs between two git tags or release branches using git log', 'get PR metadata from the GitHub API including labels, title, and merged_by information', 'extract PR numbers from git logs and categorize them by release notes label and language']
```

Usage

```
{'generate_draft_release_notes': 'run the script to generate draft release notes in Markdown from GitHub PRs between two git tags', 'generate_final_release_notes': 'run the script to generate final release notes organized by language from labeled PRs', 'get_commit_log': 'get merge commit logs between two git tags or release branches using git log', 'get_pr_data': 'get PR metadata from the GitHub API including labels, title, and merged_by information', 'get_pr_titles': 'extract PR numbers from git logs and categorize them by release notes label and language'}
```
